plainTranslation: A's growth meets B's feelings. The trine lets them flow together easily.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.

summaryDeep: Their confidence, encouragement, and appetite for possibility work smoothly with your feelings, needs, and sense of safety. It runs easily and asks little, quietly steadying the rest of the bond. Lean on how naturally this one lines up.
tension: The challenge is not conflict but complacency. Because the support is so reliable, it can fade into the background. You may forget how much this connection contributes to your well-being, or stop actively nurturing something that feels like it will always be there.
advice: Notice what this person brings into your life. Let yourself receive it fully, and make sure you give it value in return.
summaryShort: Their confidence, encouragement, and appetite for possibility work smoothly with your feelings, needs, and sense of safety.
